title: krn pr body names --worktree when the task lives in a slice worktree
body:
Why: 2026-11-14 lead slice t-e21xbq6: the krn-lead skill said to run `krn pr body --task <id>` from the repository root without --worktree, so a task created inside the slice worktree failed with exit 64 "Unknown task" and no hint; `--worktree` already existed.
Outcome: the skill's pr body line passes `--worktree .krn/worktrees/<slug>`, and the Unknown task error names the root it searched and the --worktree flag.
Proof: test/cli/pr-body.test.ts asserts the hint; npm run fast PASS.
Scope: src/cli/pr-body.ts, test/cli/pr-body.test.ts, krn-lead SKILL.md (both copies).
